title: Interactive Coding: Custom Function Creator
subtitle: Encapsulating Reusable Logic with def
description: Build modular functions across 3 interactive stages!
starter_code: # Stage 1: Define greet() and call it

challenges.title: Stage 1: Simple Function
challenges.description: Define <hlt>def greet():</hlt> that prints <hlt>"Hello World"</hlt>. Call <hlt>greet()</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
# Stage 1: Simple greeting
def greet():
    print("Hello World")

greet()

challenges.title: Stage 2: Function with Parameter
challenges.description: Define <hlt>def greet_user(name):</hlt> that prints <hlt>"Hello " + name</hlt>. Call with <hlt>"Alice"</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
# Stage 2: Parameterized function
def greet_user(name):
    print("Hello " + name)

greet_user("Alice")

challenges.title: Stage 3: Function with Return Value
challenges.description: Define <hlt>def square(x):</hlt> that returns <hlt>x * x</hlt>. Print <hlt>square(4)</hlt> and <hlt>square(5)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
# Stage 3: Return value
def square(x):
    return x * x

print(square(4))
print(square(5))
